problem: Prove that BeBee can add a sixth authored Moon Garden region with a distinct night-garden identity while reusing movement-through pollination, Honey, Flight/Buzz 3, restoration, save v4 and region analytics, without adding a new verb, currency, mandatory spend, lethal hazard or per-region lifecycle.

decision.rationale: Exact-head deterministic and Chromium evidence validates Moon Garden as region_06 in the same continuous authored world. Four new Meadows complete through the existing movement-through pollination verb, reuse Honey and Buzz 3, persist through save v4, and retain the six-slot nearby-patch visual pool. Night Lily, Starflower, moonlit palette and orbital/crystal landmarks provide authored identity without adding a hazard or management layer. The independent evaluation accepts the functional slice while carrying the geometric-art deviation to P8 visual certification.

governance.trust_boundary_change: No governance-critical file, workflow, validator, ruleset, permission or trust-boundary behavior is changed by this player-facing slice.
governance.bypass_analysis: No governance bypass is introduced or used. Exact-head CI, trusted evidence policy, deterministic tests and retained artifacts remain authoritative.
governance.rollback: Revert the Moon Garden feature commits to remove region_06 content and bounds while leaving save v4 and existing adapters authoritative.

anti_pattern.observation: A management-heavy counter-model combines crafting, building and relationship surfaces around progression.
anti_pattern.lesson: Do not turn a regional content expansion into a new management layer; Moon Garden must reuse the existing patch, Honey, upgrade, save and analytics contracts.
